// ExternalLogin: docs/01 TK-02. Leave a value empty and that provider's button stays off the
sign-in modal. The client ids are public; FacebookAppSecret is not, so set it
as ExternalLogin__FacebookAppSecret in the server environment file instead of
here. Google: console.cloud.google.com -> Credentials -> OAuth client (Web),
with this site listed under Authorised JavaScript origins. Apple: a Services
ID whose Return URL is AppleRedirectUri, character for character.
// Email: Outgoing SMTP. Leave Host empty and nothing is sent - queued mail waits in
the EmailMessages table until a server is configured. Set the password as
Email__Password in the server environment file, not here. Port 587 starts
plain and upgrades (default); set UseImplicitTls true for port 465.
